title: auth/oidc: validate_jwt returns last provider error losing earlier errors
description: crates/auth/src/oidc.rs OidcStore::validate_jwt() — iterates providers and on failure records only the last error in last_err. If provider 1 fails with Http(network error) and provider 2 fails with InvalidToken(signature), the caller receives only the InvalidToken from provider 2, masking the network error from provider 1. Operators debugging a multi-provider setup will not see all errors. A Vec<OidcError> of all failures would give operators the full picture; alternatively, log each failure at debug level as it occurs.
